description: Prompts for layout conformance runs (docs/SKILL_UPGRADE_PLAN_V2.md, Phases 5 and 10). Questions are verbatim, without the /socialized prefix used on claude.ai. Phase 10 adds the rest. The calib_ pair is the Approach B Phase 1 quick check (docs/ADAPTIVE_COMMUNICATION_PLAN.md): one question, two readers, asked in separate chats. The intent_ prompts, with layout_monolith as the decision, are the Phase 2 quick check: four intents that must not share one template.
